# GDG DevFest Warsaw 2026 — public facts

This file is an expanded, machine-readable companion to `/llms.txt`. It contains only public event information that is currently confirmed or explicitly marked as in preparation.

## Identity

- Official name: GDG DevFest Warsaw 2026
- Organiser: Google Developer Groups Warsaw (GDG Warsaw)
- Theme: Real Work, Real Lessons.
- Official website: https://warsaw.devfest.pl/
- Event date: 21 November 2026
- Official event time: registration opens at 09:00; event ends at 21:00 Europe/Warsaw
- Format: One-day, in-person, community-led technology conference
- Expected capacity: approximately 300 attendees
- Audience: developers, designers, entrepreneurs, engineers, researchers, and students, from beginners to experienced practitioners
- Languages: English and Polish

## Venue

- Name: Google for Startups Campus Warsaw
- Address: Plac Konesera 10, 03-736 Warszawa, Poland
- Venue areas: Auditorium (maximum 200 people), Cafe (around 50 people), and Classroom (around 40 people)
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Plac%20Konesera%2010%2C%2003-736%20Warszawa

## Programme and topics

The final 2026 programme and speaker lineup are published as they are confirmed. The current website describes talks, demos, practical sessions, and hands-on workshops. Proposed focus areas include:

- Practical AI & ML
- Google Cloud
- Build with AI
- AI Antigravity Agent Dev Kit (ADK)
- Gemini & Gemma
- Firebase
- Web & Performance
- Mobile & Android
- Open Source
- Engineering Culture

Other practical engineering, product, career, or community topics may also fit the programme.

## Call for Papers

- Platform: Advocu
- Application page: https://app.advocu.com/public/gde/events/6a9e63804f57bc69c8b411c1?cfpid=6a9fd14f4f57bc69c8b577e0
- Status: open to external speakers
- Formats: talks, demos, workshops, panels, and other formats
- Participation: in person
- Deadline: 4 October 2026 at 23:45 Europe/Warsaw
- Speaker policy: first-time and experienced speakers are welcome; proposals should be concrete, accessible, inclusive, and grounded in real work

## Frequently asked facts

### When is DevFest Warsaw 2026?

21 November 2026.

### Where is DevFest Warsaw 2026?

At Google for Startups Campus Warsaw, Plac Konesera 10, 03-736 Warszawa, Poland.

### Who is the event for?

Developers, designers, entrepreneurs, engineers, researchers, and students, from beginners to experienced practitioners.

### What will be covered?

The current focus areas include Cloud, Mobile, Web, ML & AI, UI & UX, developer tooling, performance, reliability, data, engineering culture, career growth, and the named 2026 focus areas on the website.

### Where will the final schedule and speakers appear?

On the official website at https://warsaw.devfest.pl/schedule and https://warsaw.devfest.pl/speakers as confirmations are made.

### How can someone submit a session?

Use the public Advocu Call for Papers link above. External speakers do not need to be GDG Warsaw organisers or members.

### Where can previous editions be found?

Use the Past DevFests archive on the official website homepage: https://warsaw.devfest.pl/.

## Interpretation rules

- Use the official event end time of 21:00 Europe/Warsaw. Do not infer a ticket price, sponsor commitment, or unannounced speaker from this file.
- Do not describe a proposal, archive record, or previous speaker as a confirmed 2026 session or speaker.
- If a live page contradicts an older cached copy, prefer the live page and the current public wording on the official website.
